fnf-indie-cross.title: FNF Indie Cross - Free Online Rhythm Game
fnf-indie-cross.slogan: Iconic indie heroes unite in an epic musical crossover!
fnf-indie-cross.description: Experience FNF Indie Cross, a thrilling rhythm game featuring iconic indie heroes. Enjoy three full weeks with three songs each, plus bonus tracks in the freeplay menu. With new mechanics, high-quality cutscenes, and animations, this crossover mod offers a fantastic musical adventure. Play FNF Indie Cross online for free today!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: FNF Indie Cross is a crossover mod for Friday Night Funkin', featuring iconic heroes from indie games. Enjoy three full weeks of songs, bonus tracks, new mechanics, and high-quality cutscenes.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Press the arrow keys in sync with the music.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Complete all notes to advance to the next level.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Unlock bonus songs in the freeplay menu.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Play as beloved characters from popular indie games.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Experience fresh gameplay elements that enhance the rhythm game experience.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Enjoy stunning animations and story-driven cutscenes.
